bioconda.name: insilicopcr
bioconda.license: MIT AND GPL-2.0-only WITH Classpath-exception-2.0 AND Apache-2.0
bioconda.summary: In silico PCR and qPCR of primer and probe assays on genome assemblies and raw sequencing reads.
bioconda.description:
insilicoPCR finds the products of PCR and qPCR assays (primer pairs, with or without
a probe) in genome assemblies (FASTA) and in raw Illumina reads (FASTQ), with BLAST+
and BBTools, and reports every product with its size, mismatches and position. It runs
on the command line (insilicoPCR -i <input> -p <primers> -o <output>) or in a window
(insilicoPCR without arguments).
